derivedScale.formula: abs(compensated global sum RHS) <= 64*SMALL*(original raw/boundary source magnitude + free-cell face-incidence magnitudes of phiHbyA and actual nonorth faceFluxCorrection)
derivedScale.assembly: fvc::div contributes an internal face once with each sign to adjacent cells; each boundary face contributes once to its owner. Each ordinary cyclic/processor global pair is represented once per adjacent cell across the pair/ranks.
derivedScale.deferredNonorth: installed-matrix-v2412/gaussLaplacianSchemes.C scalar-Gamma specialization subtracts mesh.V()*fvc::div(faceFluxCorrection), retaining actual face field when fluxRequired; both owned solver callers pass their actual phiHbyA
derivedScale.implementation: Face scale visits only free-cell incidences and no face traversal/reductions occur when every component is anchored; local source sums compensated; all ranks reduce same global component lists
derivedScale.limits: 64*SMALL is a relative backward-error allowance on original conservative assembly, with no absolute physical imbalance floor, no residualControl change; nonfinite rejects; affine jump and AMI/ACMI remain fail-closed
